notes.title: MINE 23 UPDATE 11.7.2016
notes.content:
UPDATE 11.7.2016

Bug Fixes and Changes

Multi-monitor fix, Added a button in the option under the graphics tab that cycles through the monitors.
Added progress bars in level select. 
Player low health sound does not continually play while player is at low health. 
Fixed level 2 pick-ax being ineffective while facing left. 
Crossbow damages enemies consistently. 
Switching to Windowed mode updates immediately. 
Tutorial for how to throw TnT shows consistently. 
Revamped the background sound system to more accurately play the sounds. 
Mushroom King’s mushrooms are now able to be destroyed. 
Fixed various boss projectiles to be destructible and colliders on bosses. 
Most bosses flash red when damaged. 
Several minor bug fixes. 


We have some exciting new updates for all you miners out there. Be sure to check out the new additions! We're working on the Mac version as well, and that should be up within the next few days. Until next time! Happy Mining!

notes.title: MINE UPDATE 10.31.2016
notes.content:
Update 10.31.2016
Various bug fixes
Enemy & boss balancing
Fix dynamite exploding on the player
Adjusted backwards enemy spawn points in the Puddle
Improved boss arena ambiance 
Adjusted Difficulties on Several Bosses
Fixed invincibility bug on Sickle Skull Bros
Re-Attached All-Peepers Laser to his eye
Fixed Layer issue with boss foregrounds
Fixed various projectile explosions
Lowered boss injury sounds across the board
Turned down sub boss intros
Turned off sound effects when game is paused
Turned down cave stalactite sounds
Fixed enemy projectiles 
Improved mobility of bugs in the cave
Fixed enemy sounds
Balanced enemy damage and effectiveness

Happy Halloween!!! We've been working hard to keep End of the Mine up to date. Here 's a list of the things we fixed due to your positive feedback! Keep em' coming and happy mining!

notes.title: Skirmish Store is Now Open!
notes.content:
Hey folks! Today we're announcing that the Skirmish Store is open for business! 

We're doing a limited collector's edition release for End of the Mine that can only be found in our store. This physical collector's edition includes:


Custom designed End of the Mine crate box 
EOTM Styled CD & Case 
Manual/Information Booklet 
4” V.S. Sticker 
4” Eyeball Medallion with Digital Code on back 
Miner I.D. Card 
Project Synth Promo Card


Only 1000 of these have been made, so if you want one, order soon!

We also have Camm-E plushies, EOTM T-shirts, and EOTM posters up for sale in the store. If you missed out on getting these during our Kickstarter campaign, fret not. You can now order them straight from our website! Head on over to our store to place your orders today!
